title: mcpward JSON report (schemaVersion 1)
description: Output of `mcpward run --reporter json` and `mcpward diff --json`. Additive changes (new optional fields, new rule ids, new check families) do not change schemaVersion, so unknown properties and family names are allowed.

schemaVersion.description: Report format version. Changes only on a breaking change to this shape.

version.description: mcpward version that produced the report.

protocolVersion.description: MCP protocol version negotiated with the server.

id.description: Rule id, e.g. `drift/description_changed`. Documented in docs/rules.md.

family.description: Check family. Known values: compliance, schema, drift, security, behavioral, errors, latency, collision. New families may be added without a schemaVersion change.

expected.description: Expected value, if the check compares one. Any JSON value.

actual.description: Actual value, if the check compares one. Any JSON value.

location.description: Tool name, parameter path or other location the result refers to.
